fullPassage: The human psychology and education communities (as well as some animal researchers!) have been against referring to "teaching" when describing social learning in animals, mainly because teaching implies a level of ________________ on the part of the model that is difficult to measure in animals. Nonetheless, there has been a movement within the animal cognition community to say that animals can, in fact, teach one another. For example, skilled ants engage in a behavior called tandem running, in which they touch their bodies to the body of a novice ant as they lay down chemical trails, presumably to assist the movement with route learning. Killer whales also repeat the same seal hunting technique in front of their offspring, sometimes without even killing the seal, leading researchers to ask why they would repeatedly catch and release a seal if they were not planning to eat it. Considering the amount of energy they'd have to expend, there would need to be a good reason, and that reason might be teaching.

③ pursue: 추적하다 — 잡기 전 단계이지 반의어 아님
④ observe: 관찰하다 — 다른 의미 축
det.tip: catch and release(잡고 놓아주다). release(놓아주다) ↔ capture(잡다). 본문에서도 catch와 release를 쌍으로 사용.

questions.passage:
(A) There has been a <u>movement</u> within the animal cognition community to say that animals can, in fact, teach one another.

(B) The dancer's graceful <u>movement</u> across the stage captivated the entire audience.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 movement가 의미하는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) a movement within the community = 학계 내의 흐름/움직임 / (B) dancer's movement = 무용수의 동작
det.analysis:
① (A) 동작 — (B) 흐름: (A)에서 학계 내의 movement는 사회적 '흐름/동향'이지 물리적 '동작'이 아님
② (A) 이동 — (B) 동작: (A)에서 학계 내 movement는 물리적 '이동'이 아님
③ (A) 흐름 — (B) 동작: (A) 학계의 흐름/동향, (B) 무용수의 물리적 동작 — 두 문맥 모두 정확 ←정답
④ (A) 흐름 — (B) 운반: (B)에서 무용수의 movement를 '운반'이라 할 수 없음
det.tip: movement는 다의어: (A) 사회적·지적 흐름/동향, (B) 신체적 동작/움직임.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "to use up resources such as time, energy, or effort"

det.korean: 시간, 에너지, 노력 같은 자원을 다 써버리다
det.analysis:
① preserve: 보존하다 — 자원을 쓰는 것이 아니라 지키는 것
② accumulate: 축적하다 — 쓰는 것의 반대
③ expend: 소비하다, 쓰다 — 영영 정의와 정확히 일치 ←정답
④ absorb: 흡수하다 — 다른 의미
det.tip: expend는 본문에서 'the amount of energy they'd have to expend'(소비해야 할 에너지의 양)로 사용되었다.

questions.passage: For example, skilled ants engage in a behavior called tandem running, in which they touch their bodies to the body of a novice ant as they lay down chemical trails, __________ to assist the movement with route learning. (presume)
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: presume(동사: 추정하다) → presumably(부사: 추정컨대)
det.analysis: __________(presume) to assist — 문장 내 삽입 부사로 추정의 뉘앙스를 전달. presume(동사)를 부사형 presumably로 변환.
det.tip: presumably to assist the movement — 추정컨대 이동을 돕기 위해. presume → presumably(부사).

questions.passage: Killer whales also repeat the same seal hunting technique in front of their offspring, sometimes without even killing the seal, __________ researchers to ask why they would repeatedly catch and release a seal. (lead)
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.korean: lead(동사: 이끌다) → leading(현재분사: 이끌면서)
det.analysis: __________(lead) researchers to ask — 분사구문으로 결과를 나타냄. lead(동사)를 현재분사 leading으로 변환. 주절의 주어(Killer whales)와 동일하므로 분사구문 사용.
det.tip: leading researchers to ask — 연구자들로 하여금 묻게 만들면서. lead → leading(현재분사/분사구문).

questions.passage: The human psychology and education communities (as well as some animal researchers!) have been against referring to "teaching" when describing social learning in animals, mainly because teaching implies a level of ________________ on the part of the model that is difficult to measure in animals. Nonetheless, there has been a movement within the animal cognition community to say that animals can, in fact, teach one another. For example, skilled ants engage in a behavior called tandem running, in which they touch their bodies to the body of a novice ant as they lay down chemical trails, presumably to assist the movement with route learning. Killer whales also repeat the same seal hunting technique in front of their __________, sometimes without even killing the seal, leading researchers to ask why they would repeatedly catch and release a seal if they were not planning to eat it. Considering the amount of energy they'd have to expend, there would need to be a good reason, and that reason might be teaching.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 범고래는 _____ 앞에서 같은 물개 사냥 기술을 반복한다.
det.analysis:
① trails: 흔적 — 범고래가 흔적 앞에서 기술을 반복한다는 것은 부자연스러움
② offspring: 새끼 — 새끼 앞에서 사냥 기술을 보여준다는 가르치기 맥락에 정확히 부합 ←정답
③ researchers: 연구자들 — 연구자 앞에서 기술을 보여준다는 것은 문맥 왜곡
④ communities: 공동체 — 공동체 앞에서라는 표현은 어색
det.tip: in front of their offspring — 새끼 앞에서. 가르치기의 대상이 새끼라는 맥락.

questions.passage: The human psychology and education communities (as well as some animal researchers!) have been against referring to "teaching" when describing social learning in animals, mainly because teaching implies a level of ________________ on the part of the model that is difficult to measure in animals. Nonetheless, there has been a movement within the animal cognition community to say that animals can, in fact, teach one another. For example, skilled ants engage in a behavior called tandem running, in which they touch their bodies to the body of a novice ant as they lay down chemical trails, presumably to assist the movement with __________. Killer whales also repeat the same seal hunting technique in front of their offspring, sometimes without even killing the seal, leading researchers to ask why they would repeatedly catch and release a seal if they were not planning to eat it. Considering the amount of energy they'd have to expend, there would need to be a good reason, and that reason might be teaching.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 숙련된 개미가 화학적 흔적을 남기며 초보 개미의 _____을 돕는 것으로 추정된다.
det.analysis:
① habitat restoration: 서식지 복원 — 본문에서 개미의 행동 목적이 아님
② predatory instinct: 포식 본능 — tandem running은 사냥이 아닌 경로 안내
③ social hierarchy: 사회적 위계 — 본문에서 위계 확립이 아닌 학습을 다룸
④ route learning: 경로 학습 — 화학적 흔적을 남겨 이동의 경로 학습을 돕는다는 맥락 ←정답
det.tip: presumably to assist the movement with route learning — 추정컨대 이동의 경로 학습을 돕기 위해. 개미의 tandem running 목적.
